jobs.title: Senior Delivery Manager cum Portfolio Manager – (SAP SuccessFactors)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Exciting Opportunity Alert! 🌟 HTC Global Services is hiring a Senior Delivery Manager cum Portfolio Manager – (SAP SuccessFactors) - HR Domain expert for an 1-year extendable contract in Abu Dhabi, UAE (Onsite).

HTC Global Services - a leading CMM level 5 global provider of innovative IT and Business Process Services and Solutions since 1990 with headquarters in Troy, Michigan, USA.

Role Summary

Senior Delivery Manager cum Portfolio Manager – HR Domain
will own the end-to-end HR Technology roadmap, managing budgets and driving digital transformation. The role demands an outcome-oriented leader who can independently guide technical teams using hands-on implementation experience, solve complex delivery challenges out-of-the-box, and effectively manage executive stakeholders.
Key Accountabilities

HR Technology Portfolio Leadership

Roadmap Ownership
: Own and govern the end-to-end HR Technology portfolio and transformation roadmap.
Strategic Alignment
: Define strategic technology roadmaps aligned with HR, DTI, and corporate objectives.
Smart Prioritization
: Prioritize investments, programs, and enhancements based on business value, risk, compliance, and resource availability.
Governance & Metrics
: Establish portfolio governance, delivery metrics, and executive reporting mechanisms.
Continuous Innovation
: Drive digitalization and AI-powered automation across the entire employee lifecycle.

Program & Delivery Management

End-to-End Delivery
: Lead large-scale HR technology programs from ideation through production deployment and benefits realization.
Technical Guidance
: Guide developers, architects, and squads using your hands-on technical implementation experience.
Problem Solving
: Unblock complex technical and delivery challenges with innovative, out-of-the-box thinking.
Concurrent Initiatives
: Manage multiple concurrent initiatives, agile delivery teams, and cross-functional squads.
Risk & Crisis Management
: Proactively identify, mitigate, and resolve critical delivery risks, dependencies, and blockers.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management

Primary Tech Partner
: Act as the primary technology partner for HR Leadership and Business Product Owners.
Executive Relationships
: Build strong relationships with the CHRO, HR Leadership Team, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Security.
Forum Leadership
: Lead steering committees, governance forums, and executive reviews.
Conflict Management
: Resolve team friction, vendor disputes, and competing internal priorities across all organizational levels.
Influencing Power
: Negotiate with senior stakeholders to achieve alignment and manage competing priorities.

Budget & Financial Management

Financial Oversight
: Manage annual HR Technology budgets, CAPEX, OPEX, forecasting, and investment plans.
Business Cases
: Lead business case development, funding approvals, and capital planning activities.
Value Tracking
: Track portfolio financial performance and ensure strict benefits realization management.
Cost Optimization
: Optimize technology spending to maximize business value.

Vendor & Commercial Management

Commercial Governance
: Lead supplier evaluation, RFPs, contract negotiations, and commercial governance activities.
Strategic Partnerships
: Manage strategic relationships with SAP, implementation partners, and technology vendors.
Accountability
: Govern vendor performance through strict SLAs, KPIs, and delivery commitments.

Functional Scope

The role provides technical and implementation leadership across:
Core HR
: Employee Central, Employee Master Data, Employee Contracts, Position Management, and Organization Management.
Talent & Workforce
: Recruitment, Candidate Experience, Onboarding/Crossboarding, Learning & Development, Performance Management, Career Development, Succession Planning, and Workforce Planning.
Payroll & Benefits
: Payroll Integrations, Compensation, Benefits Administration, iSave Benefits Platform, and Rewards & Recognition.
Employee Experience
: Employee Engagement Platforms, HR Self-Service, Mobile Employee Applications, Chatbots, Virtual Assistants, and AI-enabled Employee Services.

Technology Landscape Ownership

Responsible for the strategy, governance, and delivery of:
SAP SuccessFactors
: Employee Central ( Mandatory
), Recruiting Management, Onboarding, Learning, Performance & Goals, Succession & Development, Compensation, and Workforce Analytics.
SAP Ecosystem
: SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Joule, and SAP AI Capabilities.
Integration Landscape
: CPI, APIs, Middleware Platforms, Payroll Integrations, and Third-Party HR Systems.
Digital Platforms
: iSave, Employee Mobile Applications, Employee Engagement Solutions, AI & Conversational Platforms, and Bespoke HR Applications, Power Platform
Chatbots, Agentic Automation, RPA

Qualifications & Experience

Essential Experience

Overall IT Leadership
: 8+ years of IT Program, Portfolio, or Delivery Management experience.
HR Portfolio Leadership
: Minimum 5+ years leading HR Technology portfolios.
SuccessFactors Expertise
: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors.
Core HR Delivery
: At least one end-to-end implementation of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central from design through go-live.
Scale & Budget
: Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale HR transformations and managing medium portfolios.
Commercial Acumen
: Strong experience preparing business cases, securing executive funding, and managing complex vendor ecosystems.

Preferred Experience

Advanced SF Delivery
: Multiple completed SAP SuccessFactors implementations.
AI Solutions
: Experience with SAP Joule, Generative AI, and AI-powered HR solutions.
Industry Background
: Prior experience in aviation, large enterprise, or multinational organizations.
Global Delivery
: Experience delivering global HR transformation initiatives.

Education & Certifications

Education
: Bachelor's Degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. An MBA or Master's Degree is preferred.
Methodologies
: Expert in Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and hybrid delivery frameworks.
Certifications (Preferred)
: PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Agilist, or SAP SuccessFactors Certifications.

Key Competencies & Attributes

Leadership
: Highly accountable, forward-thinking, and comfortable operating independently with minimal supervision under pressure.
Communication
: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills tailored for executive-level stakeholders.
Delivery Excellence
: Proven ability to manage ambiguity, think critically, and challenge constructively to drive alignment.
Personal Attributes
: Smart, proactive, outcome-oriented, with high convincing power and excellent critical thinking skills.

Success Measures

Roadmap Execution
: Successful delivery of the HR Technology roadmap, strategic transformation objectives, and AI-driven HR capabilities.
Financial Adherence
: Budget adherence, cost optimization, and measurable value/benefits realization.
Stakeholder & Vendor Trust
: High stakeholder satisfaction scores and effective vendor delivery against SLAs.
Operational Quality
: System stability, data compliance, platform security, and high employee adoption rates.

Interested candidates please do share your updated CV to mubeenakamal.basha@htcinc.com mentioning your Current CTC, expected CTC and notice period details.
